title: ナリタブライアン登場！

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Narita Brian is so strong that she's struggled to find real competition, which has awakened a "hunger" within her. For her, racing is life.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her debut attracts the attention of the entire academy. Some even say she might have what it takes to surpass her older sister, Biwa Hayahide.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Some even expect that Brian will win the Classic Triple Crown and surpass Symboli Rudolf, drawing the attention of the Emperor herself.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Narita Brian's battle in the Twinkle Series—where the toughest foes gather—begins now!
